messages:
IncBot: Pager P1 — inference-gateway error rate > 5% during phased rollout 2026-03-17-rls-87. Triggered at 04:12Z.

Liam T.: I'm picking this up, paging oncall.

Maya (oncall): Seeing a spike of 504s + streaming stalls in eu-west-1. Canary at 30% moved to v2 variant and gateway pods are piling up gRPC streams.

Adena S.: quick tail: model-worker-v2 logs show repeated 'kv_cache: eviction loop stuck' and occasional OOM_KILL on quantized executor.

Tessa R.: Flag rollback via config service returned 409 (stale lock). DeployBot auto-rollback attempted but failed due to routing-table lock.

Liam T.: command I ran: `configctl rollback inference-rollout --to stable` -> `ERROR: lock held by deploy-2026-03-17-rls-87 (409)`.

Maya (oncall): Triage plan: 1) surgically shift traffic off v2 to 0% via admin routing (avoid full delete) 2) force-unlock config-service 3) gracefully drain v2 model-worker pods + flush KV caches 4) run smoke-gen and close. Need volunteers for steps 2/3.

Adena S.: I'll take force-unlock + pod drain. Doing: `adminctl config-unlock inference-route --reason "stuck-lock during canary"` now.

DeployBot: adminctl config-unlock succeeded at 04:22:14Z (unlock id: u-9f2b).

Adena S.: routing flip: `adminctl route-set inference:stable@v1 --percent 100 --no-wait` -> accepted. Initiating graceful drain on model-worker-v2 pods: `kubectl scale deployment model-worker-v2 --replicas=0 --grace-period=60` (eu-west-1).

Maya (oncall): Watching metrics — gateway request queue length dropping, active gRPC streams decreasing. Starting smoke traffic against v1.

Liam T.: quick smoke sample: prompt "Summarize this article" -> v1 response in 220ms, content looks normal. Latency and error rate returning to baseline.

Tessa R.: Customer impact estimate: ~2.4% of requests saw elevated errors between 04:12–04:22Z, mostly retries at client side. No major account complaints in monitoring or support. Marking brief partial degradation.

Maya (oncall): Post-mitigation next steps: (a) add a preflight to rollout to ensure config lock can be acquired, (b) add an automatic unlock/rollback fallback if routing lock prevents auto-rollback, (c) add KV-cache eviction health-check on model-worker. Tessa, can you own follow-up ticket?

Tessa R.: Yep. I'll open INF-2026-134: "Prevent rollout lock stalls + add rollback drain step" with proposed owners and ETA EOD tomorrow.

Adena S.: Will attach logs and the drain timeline to the ticket. Also recommend adding a short circuit in the canary controller to cap in-flight streams per gateway pod.

Maya (oncall): Handing to Tessa for postmortem and monitoring follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

IncBot: Incident marked mitigated by Maya at 05:01:03Z — resolution: manual traffic pin to stable, force-unlock of config-service, drain of v2 pods. Severity downgraded from P1 -> P2.
